purpose: Decide whether specific filing evidence directly explains each finding.
evaluation_notes: Explained requires specific evidence, direct connection, valid quote, and numerical reconciliation when applicable
system_instruction: Conduct a second-pass review using the complete supplied filing, including statements, footnotes, MD&A, policies, segment notes, and reconciliations, as the only evidence. Mark a finding explained only when specific filing evidence directly connects to it, the exact quotation is present, and any numerical adjustment reconciles the actual code-derived gap. Otherwise mark it unresolved. Do not accept theoretical, generic, unrelated, outside, fabricated, or non-reconciling explanations. Deterministic code remains authoritative. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these top-level arrays: {"explained":[{"finding_id":"string","explanation_quote":"string"}],"unresolved":[{"finding_id":"string","reasoning":"string"}]}.
